verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a law firm, but no evidence shows Latham describing the design of employee option plans or local schemes such as UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOPs. The Executive Compensation page only claims general compensation and benefits work and never mentions equity plans. The Book of Jargon entries (vesting schedule, cliff vesting) are glossary definitions, not a described practice.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm designs employee equity programs — option plans and local schemes like UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, or Indian ESOPs — described on its own pages
